data.turoyo: Kəzza i dəbbe lu ṣaydo, kfoyəš u kurəko w i kačke lalġul. Huwe w i kačke, šuġlo latte. Hol ʕaṣriye kəmbalʕzi b ḥḏoḏe. <...>
data.translation: Wenn die Bärin aber auf die Jagd ging, so blieb der Jüngling und das Mädchen zu Hause, und da sie nichts zu tun hatten, spielten sie mit einander bis zum Abend. <...>

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; human reciprocal participants and full temporal context beside the inherited cat-and-mouse example.

summary: The plural subject is the youth and girl; b-ḥḏoḏe marks reciprocal partners, matching the inherited b-government. The time limit hol ʕaṣriye supplies duration, while kəmbalʕzi participates in the recurrent narrative sequence.
The nearby sleeping arrangements do not independently establish a sexual meaning for the verb. The edition’s spielten and the existing broad play/schäkern gloss suffice.
The inherited quadriliteral lexeme remains under stem I. No new stem, box, collocation or sense is needed.
Two human partners in reciprocal b-ḥḏoḏe illustrate the existing play/dallying gloss, without a separate romance or sexual sense.
